notes.title: Introducing the new character concepts!
notes.content:
Hey there!

The time has come to unveil some exciting news about[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1907630/Beauties_Academy__Spellcraft_Tournament/?l=portuguese] Beauties Academy[/url]! 
After considering all of your valuable feedback regarding the current content of the game, we've decided to make some significant changes to the style and gameplay, and we're confident that you'll love the outcome.
While we continue to work on the game's development, we'd like to give you a sneak peek of the girls you'll get to know in the game and explain a bit about the context in which the story takes place! We hope that this will give you a taste of what's to come.


Rosalee is a student at Arcane Academy who wants to make a name for herself as being rich and powerful. Then, on a certain day, the perfect opportunity arises: The Spellcraft Tournament that promises immeasurable riches for students who manage to overcome all the tests. Setting herself up for success, she must compete with Mona, the popular girl at school who has always been her rival; collaborate with Kimi, her longtime friend who is shy but very dedicated to her studies; and learn with Rebecca, her sultry and strict teacher.
